title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
subtitle: ...How Unfortunate
text: When you use a “When Defeated” ability: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, use that ability again.
deployBox: When you use a “When Defeated” ability: You may use that ability again. Use this ability only once each round.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: Any ability whose trigger starts with "When defeated…" is considered a "When Defeated" ability.
